title: Middleware hook order
text: before_agent and before_model hooks run in list order, after_model hooks run in reverse order. wrap_tool_call wraps one tool call and is the right place for audit and permission checks.

title: Middleware FAQ (imported from a partner wiki)
text:
Q: Does PIIMiddleware work on tool results? A: Yes, set apply_to_tool_results=True. Q: Can middleware end a run early? A: Yes, a before_agent hook can return jump_to end.
